summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a new family of models (a whole-body vision-language-action model, an embodied-reasoning model, and an on-device VLA) that give robots whole-body control, fine dexterity, multi-robot collaboration, and fast adaptation to new robot bodies.

mechanisms.reason: The lab states it built a VLA model specifically optimized to run locally on robotic devices rather than in a datacentre.
mechanisms.quote: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 is built specifically to handle these constraints — it is our most-efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a first-time step change from upper-body/tabletop control to full whole-body humanoid control.
mechanisms.quote: For the first time, our model can now control entire humanoid robots, translating intent into intelligent whole-body control.

mechanisms.reason: Multiple robots are described coordinating autonomously to complete workflows beyond a single agent's capability, an autonomous multi-agent execution pattern.
mechanisms.quote: we are introducing multi-robot collaboration. This enables different types of robots to communicate and work together to solve complex workflows a single robot could not do alone.

practices.reason: A new robotics model family with stated gains in multi-step planning, embodied reasoning, and vision-language-action control is relevant to teams building physical-AI or agentic robotic systems, though the evaluation is the lab's own.
practices.quote: It observes the room, reasons about the steps needed to complete the task, coordinates with the VLA to carry out the actions, and tracks progress until the task is done.

practices.reason: A new safety benchmark for agentic robotic systems is introduced that a team could adapt to test their own robot's refusal and uncertainty-handling behaviour.
practices.quote: We’re introducing ASIMOV-Agentic , a new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration and uncertainty resolution.

practices.reason: Availability is stated across AI Studio, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (private preview), and early-access hardware partners, which a team would need to track to gain access rather than act on immediately.
practices.quote: Gemini Robotics ER 2, our reasoning model, is now available on Google AI Studio and in private preview on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform .
